text: haha thanks so heres another anomoly im finding in the mesh editor is so heres just a basic cube and i selected all faces and then solidify, and the internal structure is... all over the place. why isnt it uniform?[Image #1][Image #2][Image #3]
resolution: Diagnosed the non-uniform cube Solidify result in cart/editor. The native resident-mesh port accumulates one unit normal per selected triangle at each welded vertex, while a Studio cube stores each authored quad as two triangles. Diagonal endpoints therefore receive the same plane normal twice and other corners once, producing unequal offset vectors and a warped inner shell. The correct repair seam is to collapse selected triangles by authored-face group, derive each incident plane once, then solve an even-thickness miter/offset-plane intersection per welded vertex rather than normalizing a triangle-weighted sum. No code was changed because this request asked for the cause.
